rows.text:
Hello guys let’s have a first 
look on templar class in Aion 2,

the goal is to show you his abilities 
and his general gameplay so that you

can decide if you want to play it and if you 
do, to have a basic idea on how to play it.

SO first of all templar is the main 
tank of the game, But I bet you know

that already, he is super important in hard 
pvE content like the end game Raids and such.

He is also very useful on mass player pvp, sadly 
I cannot show you any footage about that, but in

general he has many crowd control abilities plus, 
obviously he can be the front line taking hits..

If you are in a rush and you just want a guide 
showing you which abilities to upgrade first

or a quick rotation, put you skills on your 
hotbar like this, set a macro on judgment and

maybe on a second line of abilities, and then 
all you have to do is to hold both your Basic

attack and Mouse macro at the same time and 
you will execute a very decent rotation that

will get your though for the whole leveling phase.
Now if you want more details about each ability,

but again nothing too deep, just a basic 
introduction, lets move onward to this video.

His first ability Vicious Strike Replenish mana, 
and the second one Pummel depleting his mana.

If you use a simple in game macro just 
by holding both of them together at the

same time you can alternate between the two 
attacks. That way not only you increase you

overall dps but you also replenish 
enough mana to never run out of it.

You need to set pummel in a macro to make the 
game think you press that key once every 10

miliseconds instead of holding it. That way 
it can fit 1 basic attack in between skills.

Pummel is one of the most important 
Templar abilities so while leveling

up make sure you upgrade it first, and 
later on upgrade it as much as possible.

The next most important ability is Judgement.
Judgement is a proc ability

triggering with multiple ways.
It Triggers when you are casting Shield Smite,

warding strike, shield Rush and Doom Shield.
At the beginning of the game it has 5 seconds

cooldown so if you want to deal maximum 
damage, you have to press each one of the

abilities that trigger it with 5 seconds delay.
For example, Shield Smite first, cast judgement.

Continue with a filler rotation,
Then Warding Strike and judgement

again, and so on.
That of course is viable

only for the very early stages of the game 
where you haven’t unlock its passives yet.

If you look down here on its passive section, 
the last one says that it removes its cooldown.

Which means not only now you don’t have to wait 5 
seconds for the next ability that will trigger it,

but you can also fit 2 or more 
casts in between each ability.

So now you might understand why I’ve said 
it is the most important ability on our kit.

That said it goes without saying you 
want to level it up as much as possible.

And that right here basically is 
the core Templar dps Gameplay.

You just press abilities that will trigger 
Judgement and you use it as much as possible.

Let’s have a look now on the rest 
of his abilities. One by one.

Poach is an extremely useful skill 
for multiple different situations.

The base skill pulls a 
target on to you and root it,

but at level 8 you can select 2 
very important passive abilities.

The first one makes you move to the 
target if the target is unmovable.

That means against bosses Poach can 
now also be used as a gab closer.

And the second passive says that it resets 
its cooldown when defeating an enemy.

This is most useful in pvE where you 
are trying to farm or leveling up,

not only because you can move from target to 
target as you killing them, but also because

at some point if you have enough damage it 
can end up being a ranged one shot attack.

Later in pvp you can also add a passive that 
gives it 50% chance to stun the target as well.

The next ability is Shield Smite, nothing 
too complicated here, its basically just an

ability that will trigger Judgement. There 
is no reason Prioritize leveling it up,

at some point you will decide if you 
want 1 or 2 passives for your not so

usefull skills. Usually most of them 
will stay at level 12 for 2 passives.

Next is flash Rmpage, a spamming ability that 
triggers when the target is staggered, again not

so important, you can ignore it early on.
And then we have Debilitating smash.

Debilitating Smash is another proc ability 
that activates when you use Shield smite

or when blocking. The pvE use is that it 
reduces the enemies Defense by 25% but you

don’t really care about it since you will 
mostly press it whenever it is available.

What you have to know however is that one of 
its passives gives it 60% healing reduction

and makes it a very powerful tool In pvP.
So bebilitating smash, is you anti heal on pvp.

Warding Strike, is an aoe ability that 
most importantly also procs Judgement.

So you want to use it on 
cooldown to proc Judgement.
Apart from that it also restore some of your hp

and also gives you a huge damage 
mitigation for a short duration.

Realisticly speaking you will just insert 
it to your auto rotation for more damage,

but its good to know that it also 
gives you some defensive power.

Then we have Shield Rush, a dashing ability that 
also has a small chance to stun an enemy. Shield

rush has a gimmick that it can be used, only 
after pressing dodge, and while you are in combat.

Usually you will dodge an enemy attack and 
then instantly return back to the target.

Or on Pvp when you are trying to reach somebody, 
you dodge towards him and then use Shield Rush.

After that we have Annihilate, another proc 
ability that it is exceptionally strong. Again,

realistically speaking you will just use it as 
soon as it becomes available, that is why we will

set most of our procs on a single key, that way we 
will spam 1 button and it will execute all of our

procs immediately when they are available..
In general Aion 2 gameplay is very fast to

keep cooldowns for a specific moment, it 
doesn’t have that kind of complexity. You

just use most of your abilities the moment 
they are available, especially in pvE.

And then we have Punishment, one of the 
most beautiful skills of the templar class.
Punishment is a charging ability which means you

can hold until it reach level 3 and 
then release it for maximum damage.

Again to no surprise you will use it on 
cooldown, and usually you will use it first.

Finally Defiance a universal ability 
that will simply remove a stun from you.

Before I move to the passive section 
lets have a look at his Stigma abilities.

If you are new stigma abilities are all very 
strong but you have to choose only a few of

them to add to your build. Simply because 
you can’t equip all of them at the same time.

So, Empyrean Lord’s Punishment, is a ranged Aoe 
attack, that also has a chance to stun the target.

As you can imagine it is very useful in pvp and 
you can also use it on Free roam Pve. Usually you

will not pick this one on hard pvE bosses.
Nezekan’s Shield, is an aoe shiled based on

your max hp to all party members for 3 seconds.
This skill will be mostly usefull when you are

expecting a raid wide aoe, or if you want 
to use it as a tank buster for yourself.

For new players, Tank buster is a heavy undodgable 
attack from a raid boss that you have to tank

it. That is why these abilities duration is 
so short, because it suppose to tank 1 hit.

Then we have Shield of Protection, the 
actual tank buster cooldown of templar.

You character stops and gains 100% 
block chance for the next 3 seconds.

Like I said before, you use 
this ability right before you

get hit for a massive attack that you cannot.
Then we have Taunt, a usual provoke ability,

only it also have some defensive 
capabilities giving you damage

tolerance and reducing the targets attack.
Apart from obviously being very useful on pvE

content, it can also Taunt Players. 
So it has its use on pvp as well.

Armor of balance will give you impact type 
resist, which means you will be stunned

harder for a short while. Obviously useful on pvp.
Second skin, will give you protections for a short

while, the thing is that the more you are leveling 
it up the more it will last, that indicates that

you can use it for big pulls inside dungeons.
So you basically pull lots of monsters then

when you’ll stop to tank them, you pop one 
of Second skin and and you are good to go.

Doom shield, is a regular Dashing ability 
with a chance to knock the enemy down,

it grants you a shield and it 
also resets annihilate Cooldown.

Annihilate was one of our 
very strong Proc abilities.

Lastly Doom shield will also proc Judgement, 
the main damage ability we were talking about

earlier. So doom will be of the stigma abilities 
that you will propably use on every build.

Noble armor is just a buff that has 100% uptime. 
Which means you can have on you at all times,

and players like it a lot because of 
all the cool stats it gives you. In

general Noble armor boosts too many 
things once it is on higher levels.

Executing Blade is an aoe ability that will 
reduces the enemy defense by 30% for 5 seconds.

That said usually we want to use 
it right before we use Punishement,
the charging ability that I was mention

earlier, since it has a huge burst damage. Using 
it before it it will boost that dmg for 30%.

Comrade in arms will give you Big 
damage tolerance and it will cover

one of your allies.. You will take 50% of 
the damage an ally was suppose to take.

Grapple is another hook that also applies 
root, only it is aoe and has a very big

cooldown. Using it on pvp hoevewr with 
good timing, can absolutely be lethal.

Assaunt fury is another gapclose and 
finally battlefield Banner is one of

best stigmas on Templar’s kit, Giving you 
Increased attack based on your Defense

The best part is that the duration is 
increased with the level you got it,

so naturally you want to upgrade it as much as 
possible. Very useful skill on both pvp and pvE.

If you are not tired yet, lets have a 
final quick look on the passives as well.

The first one is enhanced heath for bonus Hp. 
Don’t be afraid to level this up, even early on.

Warding Shield will heal you with 3 seconds 
cooldown after block and the value is

increased based on its level.
It has small leveling priority

Punishing benediction on the other 
hand,is one of your damage passives,

and usually you want to 
have it on very high levels

Ironclad Defense is also extremely useful 
passive giving you Defense and endurance

based on its level. So naturally you 
want to upgrade this a lot as well.

Guardiang Seal, it will do its work even at low 
levels so there is no reason focusing on it.

Impact Hit will help you land Knockdowns and Stuns 
to the target, so usually players want to have it

at high level if you are focusing on pvp.
Insulting Roar it’s a very straightforward

attack boost. You can level it 
up as much as you want as well.

And Fury is one of the most important offensive 
Passives you got. Giving you attack damage boost,

PvE damage boost and pvp Damge 
boost both to you and all your

party members for 20 seconds after a block.
Survival Willpower, will make it harder for your

opponents to land stuns on you. So again,if you 
like pvp you want to have this at higher levels.

And Block Pain is also an extremely usuful 
passive giving you Pvp and pvE damage tolerance

when hit by an enemy with 20 seconds cooldown.
Basically, you will haves lots of defense the

first time an enemy will hit you. 
So you are hard to be Nuked down.

And that’s it for an introduction 
to all templar abilities in Aion 2.

He is gameplay might be fast, But 
I don’t believe it is complicated,

especially if you set the right macro.
Now it is too early to give you viable macro in

this video, I played on Taiwan but I have too much 
latency to test things out, so you gonna have to

wait for the global release. Leave a sub however 
if you want templar updates on your home screen!

As always thank you all for watching 
and see you on the next one!
